problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -6 & 8 \\ -2 & -5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 12 & 18\end{aligned}].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce $M$ to row echelon form, and then find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.

examples.knowledge_point: Identifying a Singular 3x3 System of Equations That Has No Solution
examples.problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14041677/assets/a39dfc581111c2601dd5851c16fccc086a980a84b7804ef0d0800252016dce83.png)
Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce $M$ to row echelon form, and then find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.
examples.worked_solution:
Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -6 & 7 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 & 19 \\ 1 & -3 & -8 & 6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -6 & 7 \\ 0 & 3 & 6 & 12 \\ 1 & -3 & -8 & 6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -6 & 7 \\ 0 & 3 & 6 & 12 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -6 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -6 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The corresponding system is now

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-2y-6z=7 \\ 0x+y+2z=4 \\ 0x+0y+0z=3\end{aligned}
$$

Since there are no such numbers $x,y,z$ that form a solution of the final equation $0x+0y+0z = 3,$ we can conclude that our system has no solution.

feedback.problem:
Consider the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}-{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=8 \\ -5{x}_{1}+20{x}_{2}-10{x}_{3}=40 \\ \frac{1}{2}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=-4.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
feedback.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for the system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & -2 & 8 \\ -5 & 20 & -10 & 40 \\ \frac{1}{2} & -2 & 1 & -4\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & -2 & 8 \\ -5 & 20 & -10 & 40 \\ \frac{1}{2} & -2 & 1 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=-{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & 2 & -8 \\ -5 & 20 & -10 & 40 \\ \frac{1}{2} & -2 & 1 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+5{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & 2 & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ \frac{1}{2} & -2 & 1 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-\frac{1}{2}){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & 2 & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
